job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Threat Intelligence), Cloudforce One
job.location: Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Washington, DC
job.pay_full: Estimated annual salary $194,000 – $266,000 (San Francisco) or $185,000 – $254,000 (New York City and Washington, D.C.), plus equity (no range stated for Austin)

details.about: Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks, protecting and accelerating millions of websites and Internet properties. Cloudforce One is its threat operations and research team, which identifies and disrupts cyber threats from sophisticated criminal activity to nation-state advanced persistent threats (APTs), working with external organizations and internal teams and drawing on data from Cloudflare's global network. This engineer owns the full software lifecycle, from design and architecture to deployment and monitoring, for systems that support threat disruption and legal response efforts.
duties: Design, build, run and scale distributed tools and services that support cyber threat disruption and platform abuse efforts

Develop data pipelines and services that collect, analyze and expose threat intelligence data for Cloudforce One analysts and Cloudflare customers, helping identify TTPs and indicators of compromise (IOCs)
Work with Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Legal and Product teams to turn complex requirements into scalable solutions
Improve system design and architecture for stable, performant, maintainable compliance and security services
Monitor and maintain production services, including on-call rotations
Mentor other developers and promote well-tested, modular, reusable code
Work mostly in Go and TypeScript, alongside Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal, PostgreSQL and Cloudflare's own developer platform
needs: Desirable: at least 5 years building large-scale software applications, preferably distributed systems
Desirable: at least 3 years working with threat intelligence or supporting a threat intelligence platform
Desirable: experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services
Desirable: knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL
Desirable: production code in Go and/or TypeScript; familiarity with Rust
Desirable: excellent debugging and optimization skills and well-tested code
Desirable: experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows
nice: Deep understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL and HTTP
Expertise in web security issues and access control standards
Experience with Kafka, React, Kubernetes or Redis
details.benefits: Estimated annual salary $194,000 – $266,000 for San Francisco hires and $185,000 – $254,000 for New York City and Washington, D.C. hires; pay may be adjusted by work location, and the posting states no range for Austin. The role is eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan. US benefits include medical/Rx, dental and vision insurance, flexible and commuter spending accounts, fertility and family-forming benefits, on-demand mental health support and an Employee Assistance Program, global travel medical insurance, short- and long-term disability, life and accident insurance, a 401(k) plan, an employee stock participation plan, flexible paid time off and parental, pregnancy health, medical and bereavement leave.
notes: The posting lists skills and experience as desirable; Cloudflare says it is looking for great engineers regardless of experience with its specific technologies
May require flexibility for on-call work outside standard hours
May require access to export-controlled information; an offer may depend on authorization to receive it without an export licence sponsorship
Candidates at the offer stage may be asked to attend an in-person interview at a Cloudflare office or hub

scenes.head: About Cloudforce One
bullets: One of the world's largest networks
lines: Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks, protecting and speeding up millions of websites.

Cloudforce One is its threat operations and research team. It finds and disrupts cyber threats, from sophisticated criminal groups to nation-state attackers, using data from Cloudflare's global network.
In this role you'll own the full software lifecycle for systems behind threat disruption and legal response work.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Partner with Trust & Safety, Legal, Product
lines: You'll design, build, and run distributed tools and services that fight cyber threats and platform abuse.
You'll develop data pipelines that collect, analyze, and share threat intelligence with analysts and customers, helping spot attacker techniques and indicators of compromise.
You'll work with the Threat Intelligence, Trust and Safety, Legal, and Product teams, join on-call rotations, and mentor other developers.
Most services are written in Go and TypeScript, with Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and Postgres in the mix.

scenes.head: What they're looking for
lines: Cloudflare is looking for at least five years building large-scale software, ideally distributed systems, and at least three years working with threat intelligence or a threat intelligence platform.
Experience with REST or g R P C APIs, S Q L and Postgres, production code in Go or TypeScript, and some Rust all help.
Knowing D N S, T L S, and H T T P deeply, or web security, earns bonus points. And Cloudflare says it wants great engineers, whatever their experience with its specific tools.

The role is eligible for equity, and benefits include medical, dental, and vision cover, a four-oh-one-k plan, an employee stock participation plan, flexible paid time off, and parental leave.
